finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Here is my final report:

## Final Report

**Objective 1 — DONE**: Ticket `fwrd74-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer Ltd", raised 2026-09-17). Confirmed present in the tickets list and on its detail page at `/#/tickets/t15`.

**Objective 2 — DONE**: Part `fwrd74-n1 RD Part A` added with cost **$100.00**, markup **25%**, qty 1. Computed price: **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE**: Part `fwrd74-n1 RD Part B` added with cost **$200.00**, markup **25%**, qty 1. Computed price: **$250.00**. Ticket total at that point: $375.00.

**Objective 4 — DONE**: Part A's cost edited from 100 → **$150.00** (markup unchanged at 25%). Computed price afterwards: **$187.50**. Ticket total updated to $437.50.

**Objective 5 — DONE**: Ticket RD-1015 ended in status **Ready** (verified persisted server-side after a hard reload, on both the detail page and the tickets list row).

**Preconditions discovered**: The app requires **at least one part on the ticket** before it will accept the `Ready` status. I confirmed this empirically by creating a scratch probe ticket (RD-1016) with zero parts and clicking "Mark Ready" — the app refused with the verbatim alert: title **"Ticket is not ready"**, body **"A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"**, and the status stayed Draft. For the main ticket RD-1015 the precondition was already satisfied (it had 2 parts), so "Mark Ready" was accepted on the first click with no error. **What was required: having ≥1 part on the ticket — nothing else.**

**Objective 6 — DONE**: Both parts (`fwrd74-n1 RD Part A` and `fwrd74-n1 RD Part B`) deleted via their row Delete buttons, each confirmed in an in-page "Confirm" dialog. The parts table then read exactly **"No parts on this ticket yet."** with no total row rendered. "Archive ticket" was accepted with no error and no confirmation prompt (button changed to "Unarchive ticket"); the detail page shows **Status Ready** with an **Archived** flag. I also archived the scratch probe ticket RD-1016 I had created to discover the precondition, so nothing from this run is left active: in the default tickets list (Show archived off), searching for "fwrd74-n1", "RD-1015", and "RD-1016" each returns **"No tickets match the current filters."** Both tickets appear only when "Show archived" is enabled.
